completenessNote: 来源为 AGC 官方 PDF《S-4_2026-E.pdf》（2 页），本次切分 3 条。该 PDF 为扫描件 + OCR 文本层，正文按版式位置重建：已剔除页眉页脚与边栏条标题、回接折行；未改写措辞、未增删内容。OCR 层面可能存在个别粘连或形近字，逐字引用请以原始 PDF 为准。

text.en: This Order may be cited as the Passports (Visa) (Exemption) (Amendment) Order, 2026 and shall be deemed to have commenced on 3rd July 2025.

heading.en: Amendment of Schedule 3 to 0 1 of Chapter 146

text.en: Schedule 3 to the Passports (Visa) (Exemption) Order, in this Order referred to as the principal Order, is amended by inserting the following new item immediately after "The Kingdom of Cambodia" - "48A. The Republic of Kosovo". Amendment of Schedule 4

Schedule 4 to the principal Order is amended by inserting the following new item immediately after "The Kingdom of Cambodia"- "45A. The Republic of Kosovo". Made this 25th. day of Rejab, 1447 Hijriah corresponding to the 15th. day of January, 2026 at Our Istana Nurul Iman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam.

HIS MAJESTY

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN, BRUNEI DARUSSALAM. Dicetak oleh Print Plus Sdn. Bhd., Bandar Seri Begawan BB3510, Negara Brunei Darussalam.
